cis_text.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity

ai_guidance.llm: Enforce strict network and storage segmentation between AI training environments, inference pipelines, and retrieval corpora, isolating high-trust model components from untrusted external inputs and general enterprise networks. Without explicit trust boundaries, low-trust external content (like emails) can contaminate core knowledge bases, and compromised training pipelines can be used to inject backdoors; segmentation limits the blast radius and prevents lateral movement into sensitive model systems.
ai_guidance.agent: Separate sensitive data across agent workspaces and contexts. Ensure that agents serving different departments, workflows, or trust zones cannot access or leak data across boundaries. Segregate memory stores, retrieval scopes, tool permissions, and execution environments.
ai_guidance.mcp: Isolate servers that access highly sensitive data. Separate third-party servers from enterprise-developed servers. Limit sampling to approved model endpoints and match provider contracts to data handling needs. Consider dedicated gateways with tighter authorization for high-risk groups.

evidence.rationale: Segmentation directly limits attacker movement between remote-accessible systems and sensitive environments.
Segregated cloud environments reduce exposure of sensitive cloud storage resources.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
